original_prompt: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.8.2"
    node_exporter_arch: "linux-amd64"
    node_exporter_checksum: "sha256:291c513f8b99b2a2c4eb2c3b2c8e2a0e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e"
    node_exporter_user: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_group: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_listen_address: ":9100"
  tasks:
    - name: Create node_exporter group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create node_exporter user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        createhome: false

    - name: Download node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
        checksum: "{{ node_exporter_checksum }}"
        mode: "0644"

    - name: Extract node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp"
        remote_src: true
        creates: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.{{ node_exporter_arch }}/node_exporter"

    - name: Install node_exporter binary
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.{{ node_exporter_arch }}/node_exporter"
        dest: "/usr/local/bin/node_exporter"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true

    - name: Create systemd service file
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: "node_exporter.service.j2"
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      notify: Restart node_exporter

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start node_exporter service
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        state: started
        enabled: true

  handlers:
    - name: Restart node_exporter
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        state: restarted

# node_exporter.service.j2 content (inline for single-file playbook)
# Place this as a separate file in roles or use blockinfile in real deployment
# For single playbook output, the service is defined via template task above.
# Equivalent service content:
# [Unit]
# Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
# After=network.target
#
# [Service]
# Type=simple
# User={{ node_exporter_user }}
# Group={{ node_exporter_group }}
# ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/node_exporter --web.listen-address={{ node_exporter_listen_address }}
# Restart=always
# RestartSec=5
#
# [Install]
# WantedBy=multi-user.target
